subject: Tomorrow is Ananda's Birthday – Celebrate with Luca
body:
Tomorrow we celebrate the founding of Ananda on July 4, 1969. This is also Sister Gyanamata's birthday, a great devotee of Master who demonstrated the highest levels of spiritual attainment.

Ananda was founded as an intentional community dedicated to living Master's teachings in daily life. It represents a vision of spiritual living, service, and community that continues to inspire seekers around the world.

As we honor this special day, let us reflect on the principles of community living, service, and the practical application of Master's teachings.

Here are some questions to explore with Luca:
{{exampleQuestions}}

May this day deepen your connection to the Ananda community and its values.

In divine friendship,
The Luca Team
